messages:
Auditor_Claire: Hi team — for the ISO evidence packet we need proof that the RBAC change on 2024-06-10 (svc-account elevation during vuln triage) was scoped, logged, and tied to KMS usage. Can you provide the exported artifacts and a short mapping to controls?

maria-devsec: Ack. I can pull the RBAC audit trail + KMS decrypt logs. Which controls does the auditor want mapped? SOC2/ISO mapping table?

Auditor_Claire: SOC2 CC6 & ISO 27001 A.9/A.12 primarily. A brief mapping is fine, plus the raw exports. Need chain-of-custody for the artifacts.

alex-oncall: Putting together the logs now. Note: the svc-account was elevated via the admin-runbook flow for incident INC-20240610-17. I will include the PR/approval link and the short-lived role grant entry.

sam-sre: Quick heads-up — KMS decrypt events are in CloudTrail and forwarded to Splunk. I'll run the query to pull DECRYPT for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-efgh and cross-ref the CloudTrail event IDs with the RBAC change.

maria-devsec: Here's the Splunk query I ran to find the decrypts: ```index=cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt keyId="abcd-efgh" userIdentity.sessionContext.sessionIssuer.userName="svc-incident-runbook" | sort _time``` Output has 3 events around the incident window.

alex-oncall: Exported RBAC change entry (role-binding delta) from our auth DB: link (internal) presigned: https://internal.redwood/snapshots/INC-20240610/rbac-delta-3.json (accessed-only by auditors).

ops-bot: Export job complete: s3://redwood-audit-exports/INC-20240610/evidence-bundle-6162468060.tar.gz (expires 7d). Manifest: https://internal.redwood/manifest/6162468060

Auditor_Claire: Thanks — can you confirm the mapping fields we'll include in the manifest? Need: event_id, user, action, pre_state, post_state, approval_ticket, KMS_event_id, CloudTrail_event_id, exported_hash (SHA256).

maria-devsec: Yes. Manifest will include those fields and a signed SHA256 for each artifact. We'll redact unrelated PII from logs (IPs masked). Confirming chain-of-custody: export created by alex-oncall, checksum computed by ops-bot, stored in S3 with access grant to auditor group.

sam-sre: One note: there was a transient worker pod that also performed a Decrypt call (correlated by session id). I've added a short note in the manifest to explain why it looks like two principals — it's the runbook service acting on behalf of svc-account.

Auditor_Claire: Perfect. For completeness, can you attach the short narrative (1 paragraph) that ties the RBAC delta to the vulnerability triage decision and the fallback plan if the key had been unavailable?

alex-oncall: Drafting the narrative now. Will include: why elevation occurred, approvals (ticket PD-4873), time-limited TTL of the grant, and fallback to read-only model + emergency escalation.

maria-devsec: Final exports uploaded. Manifest entry: ```{"artifact":"evidence-bundle-6162468060.tar.gz","sha256":"b1946ac92492d2347c6235b4d2611184","created_by":"alex-oncall","notes":"PII redacted, pod-session explained"}```

ops-bot: Auditor access granted to group auditors@redwood for 168 hours. Download link emailed to Auditor_Claire.

Auditor_Claire: Received the bundle and the manifest. One last ask: can you include the query strings you used to generate the artifacts (for reproducibility)?

maria-devsec: Added the exact Splunk and CloudTrail queries to the manifest (and included timestamps). Example CloudTrail filter: ```{ "eventName": ["Decrypt"], "resources": ["arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-efgh"], "startTime":"2024-06-10T16:00:00Z","endTime":"2024-06-10T18:00:00Z" }```

sam-sre: Also added the RBAC export command we used: ```pg_dump --table=role_bindings --where="ticket='PD-4873'" > rbac-delta-INC-20240610.sql```

Auditor_Claire: This is exactly what I needed — thanks everyone. I'll mark the evidence as accepted unless I dig something else in review. :thumbsup:

alex-oncall: Great. Filing a short post-incident note linking to the evidence bundle and adding it to the ISO control pack.

maria-devsec: Closing the export task in JIRA: SEC-1347. Leaving a pointer to the manifest and the auditor email thread.

ops-bot: Ticket SEC-1347 status changed to Resolved by maria-devsec at 2024-06-11T09:12:45Z.
